catalog_revision_note: 2026-10-15: Added explicit residual function contracts for cross-platform distribution, native GlobusOS/Windows/Linux boundaries, node/RPC status, SDK cross-language conformance, Aurora approval gates, transaction validation, consensus/finality decision tracking, and canonical bytecode decoding. These additions are capability contracts, not implementation or verification claims. Source reconciliation remains incomplete; unknown consensus/finality and ATCB-vs-ATC1 remain BLOCKED. Source-evidence addendum: mapped monetary policy, custom hash/PoH, bounded VM transition, Devnet chain/gossip, and wallet/TX-V2 functions to exact a-townchain HEAD a5e689671b1870699c7a1750f8a166e83590a41c and observed file blobs. These remain source-mapped, not functionally verified; hash, PoH, Devnet gossip, TX-V2 end-to-end, security and full-census gates remain residual/blocked. Exact-head metadata reconciliation: updated legacy a-townchain function bindings only after checking each referenced path at HEAD a5e689671b1870699c7a1750f8a166e83590a41c; recorded current file blob SHAs, corrected the COMP-NODE canonical source inventory to a-townchain/components/node, and retained atc-node as a migration-source candidate. This does not complete source census or functional verification. EVM architecture addendum (2026-10-15): added COMP-EVM-COMPAT and FN-EVM-COMPAT-001..005 as separate, BLOCKED architecture/function contracts. Added ATC-EVM-COMPATIBILITY-DECISION-001.md. No option selected; no EVM compatibility or implementation is asserted; native ATC-VM remains unchanged pending explicit approval. Guest OS virtualization addendum (2026-10-15): added COMP-GUEST-OS-VIRT and FN-GUEST-VIRT-001..005 for hosted Windows/Linux VMs, backend/profile selection, capability/resource isolation, desktop console integration, and compatibility verification. Added GLOBUSOS-GUEST-OS-VIRTUALIZATION-001.md. Native dual boot is separately scoped; backend not selected; implementation and verification are not claimed. Contract-analysis migration (2026-10-15): added machine-readable purpose, inputs/outputs, preconditions, behavior, architecture placement, consumers, reuse, failure semantics, and source evidence for each function. Unknown call graph, side effects, trust boundaries, error contract, and reuse remain explicitly UNRESOLVED; this migration is not source or functional verification. Added 10 user-facing control/UI/system-area components and 20 explicit function contracts on 2026-10-15. All new entries remain UNBOUND_RESIDUAL with no implementation claim; owner SSOTs are retained. 2026-10-15: Added COMP-API-ORCHESTRATOR and FN-API-ORCH-001..011 as residual contract records after ownership search. Python/ATCLang evidence is documentation-only; canonical implementation owner remains unresolved; IF-010 is proposed/residual. 2026-10-15: Added COMP-MAINTENANCE-LIFECYCLE and FN-MAINT-000..024 plus IF-011/IF-012 aligned to atc-standards Issue #112. Catalog/control-plane registration only; no runtime implementation or verification is asserted. 2026-10-15: Added connection_matrix schema 1.0.0 covering declared component dependencies and critical cross-component paths. Matrix entries are RESIDUAL/BLOCKED/EXCLUDED until canonical source bindings and exact-SHA conformance evidence exist; no connection is marked VERIFIED by inference. Matrix count fields clarified: declared dependency edges, unique dependency pairs, and additional critical paths are reported separately. 2026-10-15: Added shared GlobusOS UI primitives component covering settings/options, menus, dropdowns, sliders, switches, buttons, lever/actuator controls, form inputs, positions/layout, dialogs, status, accessibility, state persistence and event routing. All new contracts are RESIDUAL/UNBOUND_RESIDUAL. 2026-10-15: Added partial exact-HEAD GlobusOS source bindings for six existing desktop/input/state/notification contracts; source mapping only, UI toolkit census incomplete and all affected functions remain RESIDUAL. File-format registry supplement (2026-10-15): added residual/blocked format-processing function contracts for normative format profiles, ATC-VM bytecode, transaction/block/state containers, OS/boot/install/package/virtualization images, Aurora model formats, config/WASM validation, build provenance, and exact-SHA evidence binding. No source implementation or verification is claimed. ATCLang current-head reconciliation: COMP-LANG source commit/tree and file blob bindings refreshed; four residual compiler contracts added. No readiness promotion or verification claim. | 2026-10-15: Added evidence-backed G1 feature reconciliation matrix; COMP-LANG remains RESIDUAL/BLOCKED because the frozen G1 spec/registry and canonical Rust subset are not equivalent/proven, and Python reference provenance is stale.

release_decision.reason: Source mappings for selected canonical a-townchain functions have been added, but full bidirectional source reconciliation, exact-head terminal test evidence, independent hash security review, consensus/finality decisions, wallet/TX-V2 end-to-end verification, and ATCB-vs-ATC1 resolution remain incomplete. EVM compatibility is separately documented as an OPEN architecture decision; no EVM option/profile is approved, and no implementation/conformance is claimed. GlobusOS guest-OS virtualization is cataloged as a proposed capability; backend, supported matrix, implementation, isolation tests and exact-head evidence remain unresolved. User-facing desktop shell, control panels, system monitoring/administration, device/security center, A-TownChain dashboard, Aurora controls, virtualization controls and developer tools are now cataloged as residual/unbound contracts; their canonical source bindings and exact-head tests remain incomplete.
forbidden_shortcuts: archive or delete source repositories based on catalog alone

scope.rule: Repository and component census entries are not proof of function completeness. Every component records its observed source repository/head and every catalog function records source_binding status; only source paths, exported symbols/entrypoints and exact-SHA evidence can advance these fields. Unknown functions must be added; unrepresented files/functions require a reasoned exclusion.
scope.catalog_addition_note: This revision adds missing capability contracts but does not claim source-census completeness. Each new record with source_binding.status UNBOUND_RESIDUAL must be source-mapped or excluded with a reproducible reason. UI/control-panel/system-area extension adds 10 components and 20 contracts. New functions remain UNBOUND_RESIDUAL pending exact source-path/symbol reconciliation; the control plane does not implement UI or privileged services. Shared UI primitives add 1 component and 35 function contracts; UI consumer dependencies are recorded in connection_matrix. All remain UNBOUND_RESIDUAL until source reconciliation.

connection_matrix.purpose: Repository-level integration matrix describing declared dependencies and additional critical cross-component paths. This is a planning and evidence register, not proof that interfaces are implemented.
connection_matrix.authority: Catalog/control-plane only; normative contracts belong in atc-standards; executable behavior belongs to each canonical component repository.
connection_matrix.direction_semantics: provider supplies a dependency or contract; consumer depends on it. Existing interface records are cross-referenced but are not silently rewritten when their direction differs.

status_semantics.RESIDUAL: Connection required or declared, but source binding and conformance evidence are incomplete.
status_semantics.BLOCKED: Integration must not be treated as available until the blocking architecture or implementation decision is resolved.
status_semantics.EXCLUDED: Explicitly excluded from production integration/drift gate.

integration_order.name: Normative contracts and ownership
integration_order.gate: Resolve SSOT, owner, versioning, canonical encodings, error semantics and registry IDs first.

integration_order.name: Kernel and operating system
integration_order.gate: Capability/IPC ABI, privilege boundaries, resource limits and recovery behavior.

integration_order.name: Chain and execution
integration_order.gate: Canonical transaction/bytecode vectors, deterministic state semantics, typed errors and no duplicate consensus/VM.

integration_order.name: AI and privileged actions
integration_order.gate: Capability policy, user approval, quota, audit and key custody.

integration_order.name: Distribution, virtualization and maintenance
integration_order.gate: Exact platform support matrix, signed artifacts, backup/rollback and evidence-bound release readiness.

integration_order.name: Developer and domain tools
integration_order.gate: Versioned schemas, reproducible artifacts, compatibility and integration tests.

acceptance_gate: Every connection has provider and consumer repository owner.
Every production connection has a versioned interface/schema and exact source path/symbol.
Compatibility, typed errors, cancellation/deadline and security boundaries are explicit where relevant.
Positive, negative, failure-injection and cross-version tests exist.
Exact full SHA, workflow run/job/step, terminal conclusion, exit code, logs and artifact hashes are recorded.
No unknown/blocked interface is treated as available; no green-CI-only verification.
demo-repository remains excluded from the live drift gate.
One SSOT per implementation; catalog does not create a second runtime.
